newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 15.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin tells U.S. visitors that more Sino-U.S. economic cooperation and closer trade ties will help create open, healthy climate for ties
- China to keep land sown with cereal crops at no less than 110.7 million hectares and aims to keep grain output at 480 million tonnes this year.
- Vice-Premier Zhu Rongji reviews outcome of macro-economic policy and looks to bright prospects of development in China's economy.
- Millions of Chinese watched television documentary on life of Deng Xiaoping, in first time Chinese so enthusiastic about a television documentary.
- Five big state banks vow to back reforms
- China Construction Bank says China Agribusiness Development Trust and Investment Corp securities operations to continue as normal
- China hopes to find taller male swimmers, as tall as 1.9 metres
- CCTV sells more than 800 sets of videotapes of Deng Xiaoping documentary
- People's Insurance Company of China reports profit of 1.0 billion yuan in 1996
- Construction Minister Hou Jie calls for more effective measures to invigorate housing market and encourage private purchase of apartments
- Aviation Industries of China pledges to increase production of modern military and civilian airplanes this year
